name: typing-animation
title: Typing Animation
usage:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { TypingAnimation } from '@/components/ui/typing-animation'
</script>

<template>
  <TypingAnimation text="Hello World! 👋" />

  <TypingAnimation :words="['Design', 'Build', 'Ship']" loop />
</template>

props.name: text
props.description: A single string to type. When omitted, the plain-text content of the default slot is used instead (Magic UI's `children`).

props.name: words
props.description: Strings to type and delete in sequence. Takes precedence over `text`.

props.name: duration
props.description: Milliseconds per character; the typing speed when `typeSpeed` is not set.

props.name: delay
props.description: Milliseconds to wait before typing starts.

props.name: pauseDelay
props.description: Milliseconds to pause on a finished word before deleting it.

props.name: loop
props.description: Keep cycling through the words forever.

props.name: startOnView
props.description: Wait until 30% of the element is in view before typing.

props.name: blinkCursor
props.description: Blink the cursor (paused for reduced motion).

slots.name: default
slots.description: Plain text to type, used when neither `text` nor `words` is set.
